aboutText: Williamstown Flooring Co. has been transforming homes and businesses across Williamstown North and Melbourne's west for over 15 years. From original hardwood floors in period homes to modern hybrid installs for busy families, we deliver precision craftsmanship every time. We specialise in timber and hardwood installation, laminate and floating floors, vinyl and hybrid solutions, plus expert sanding, finishing and subfloor preparation throughout Williamstown and surrounding suburbs.
servicesText: From supply to final finish, Williamstown Flooring Co. delivers a complete flooring solution. We work with timber, laminate, vinyl and hybrid materials for homes, shops and offices across Williamstown North and Melbourne's inner west.
